name: AXM Review & Promotion Inbox
actions: submit an exact artifact for attributed review
queue one to ten distinct attributed seats
inspect a typed held retention-audit artifact
inspect a typed transition-history divergence artifact
cast a distinct attributed review decision
accept a detached host-key authenticated submission envelope
accept a detached host-key authenticated vote envelope
discuss a held or rejected item
send an item to changed-digest repair
summary: One review surface for read-only structural evidence, single-host serialized attributed exact-digest decisions, an intent-first recoverable host-key authority view, and explicit host-local evidence-preserving lease retirement with bounded recovery, append-only intent withdrawal, per-artifact process-crash-consistent publication, and privacy-minimized durable-intent-first lossless residual-stage archival, plus fail-closed typed views for held retention audits and transition-history divergence evidence.
notes: Cooperating single-host ReviewService and ReviewAuthority mutations share an exclusive-create lease. A separate host-local CLI can retire exact owner evidence only after a closed operator assertion, digest-bound confirmation, and reason; raw bytes are quarantined first. Retirement intent, decision, and result JSON is written and fsynced in a private same-filesystem stage, then published without overwrite through a hard link, so the authoritative path is absent before publication and contains complete bytes after it. Residual non-authoritative stages are visible through bounded host-local publication-status and are never reclaimed automatically. A separate exact stage plan validates the staged JSON and classifies the authoritative target and archive. Before removing any active stage path, the archival route publishes an append-only intent bound to the exact closed request, staged artifact digest, target classification, assertion, confirmation, and exact raw-reason digest. New v2 intents and v3 results omit the raw reason and retain only a diagnostic-redaction summary, or a fixed withheld marker when no recognized pattern changed the input; labeled credentials, recognized token fingerprints, private-key blocks, and machine paths are covered, but arbitrary or encoded secret absence is not proven. Existing v1 intents remain exact-readable and retryable as explicitly typed legacy raw-reason records and are never rewritten or deleted automatically. CLI argument transport and shell history are outside the emitted-JSON redaction claim. Intent and archive publication both use complete fsynced private stages and exclusive same-filesystem hard links. Their non-authoritative residual stages remain visible and are not reclaimed automatically. Conflicting or corrupt intents hold archival, matching cooperating callers converge, and exact v1.3 archives or archive-link checkpoints without an intent remain explicitly authorization-unknown instead of receiving fabricated retrospective evidence; an active legacy checkpoint stage is not unlinked. Archival never mutates the authoritative target or owner lock and never deletes the bytes or claims storage-space reclamation. The durable intent authenticates no actor and proves no consent or publisher termination. If retirement is interrupted after intent or quarantine, bounded status classifies the exact files and a second assertion/action/id/digest confirmation can resume or finalize only matching evidence. An undecided intent-only record may instead receive an explicit withdrawal assertion and id/digest-bound confirmation. An exclusive append-only decision file makes cooperating single-host proceed and withdrawal callers converge to one decision while preserving the owner lock on withdrawal; ambiguity can be repaired one exact intent at a time. Retirement, recovery, withdrawal, publication status, intent status, and stage archival are never automatic or available through the API/browser. They do not prove holder or publisher termination, liveness, live-publisher safety, power-loss durability, or cross-file atomicity, and a false assertion can violate serialization or interrupt a live publisher. Publication and archival require same-filesystem hard-link support and prove no fallback, storage reclamation, bounded archive retention, multi-host/network-filesystem safety, external-writer exclusion, protected storage, or actor authentication. Exact-digest approval never resolves a retention hold, reconciles divergent histories, or applies an action by itself.
